purpose: Fail closed when named critical intelligence disappears from the canonical capture surface OR is hollowed out while remaining present.

policy.integrity_rule: Presence is NECESSARY AND NOT SUFFICIENT. A protected object that still exists but has lost a required governed field has been destroyed in all but filename, and must fail closed exactly as a deletion would.
policy.why: PR #1554 ('migrate SN-0358 and SN-0359 to v2 capture schema') kept both files present while removing epistemic_state, falsifier, measurement_contract, successor_effect, captured_by, director, ratification and restoration_provenance. The presence-only check introduced in #1551 was satisfied by that migration. A protection that can be passed by gutting the object is not a protection.
retirement_requires: named replacement or supersession when applicable
